name: Mellieħa Bay (Għadira)
notes: Main kite spot in Malta; works with NE (gregale) and E onshore. Mostly outside the bathing season (summer swimming zones).

country: # pro: guides disagree on whether Golden Bay or Mellieħa is the top spot; swimming-zone closure in summer

name: Golden Bay
notes: Sandy bay open to the NW, works with NW cold-front winds (onshore); for more experienced riders than Mellieħa. Swimming-zone lines close the beach to kiting in summer, check locally.
